crop.notes: Clipping covers the full first column of the story; it continues in the next column (Sullivan party's journey to the train), which is not in the crop. Both Allen mentions are inside the clipping.

ocr.notes: Gist and names readable (Tom Allen, Tom Kelley, Dalys, Fred Watkins, Hugh McManus) but many broken words and line-edge errors.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Globe-Democrat reported from New Orleans on the eve of the Sullivan-Kilrain fight that Tom Allen and Tom Kelley had arrived with a St. Louis party and both favored Jake Kilrain.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Globe-Democrat, Monday Morning, July 8, 1889, front page. Dispatch dated New Orleans, July 7.

facts.fact: Allen traveled from St. Louis to New Orleans with a St. Louis sporting party (the Dalys, Tom Kelley, Fred Watkins, Hugh McManus) for the Sullivan-Kilrain championship fight, stopping at the St. Charles Hotel
Allen and Tom Kelley favored Jake Kilrain to beat John L. Sullivan in their championship fight

notes: Allen is only two short mentions in a long fight-eve story, so focus suggested passing.
